summary: The implementation fully achieves the saved plan: it adds a shared untrusted external evidence renderer with source provenance and boundary policy, applies it to PR review thread/comment and CI check-log repair prompts, preserves the existing decision/footer policies including Do NOT push and CI check integrity, and adds adversarial helper, prompt, and runner regression tests. Existing validation evidence records the targeted prompt tests, runner tests, ruff check, and mypy check passing after the implementation commit.
